items.issue: Earlier review wording overclassified H28-7 as a duplicate of tested radiometric-front features. D-confirm and the H29 canary show that related radiometric value/gradient features were tested, but the exact orientation-coherent, multi-scale persistence/line-integral operator is not documented as a separate holdout. The full related arms underperformed their controls; this reduces priority but does not establish the exact operator as failed.
items.action: Treat H28-7 as an untested, lower-priority operator hypothesis with substantial feature-family overlap, not as an exact duplicate or as a fresh data source. Do not claim efficacy. Require an assigned lane, fresh preregistration, individual-feature canaries and a matched spatial holdout before implementation/promotion; see knowledge/41_session19_repo_review_2026-10-29.md.
